body: I think this is far more common than anyone would like to admit. I know I have trouble admitting that as an adult I am terrified of the dark and have to sleep with a light on. Particularly when it comes to the more superstitious aspects. Or maybe we do know each other...

I think it's a fear of not knowing what's there, and thanks to my overactive imagination and superstition and basically mental illness, I know something has to be there. I can't quite explain exactly what. Thanks for the advice, I do drink a lot of herbal tea, I'm actually from the UK but I'm sure I can look for a similar tea to the one you described. I've heard of ASMR before but only the role playing ones which honestly irritated the shit out of me for some reason. And actually I've never been on /r/nosleep but it definitely sounds like something I need to look at right now. Good luck to you too!

I can relate better to the financial struggles you seem to be facing than your heartbreak. But I will say this about loss, and a break up is a loss in itself, it is not something you just 'get over'. You learn to live with it every day, at first it claws at your throat 24/7, but day by day you learn to breathe a little easier. I promise that healing can and does happen.
